maddeler.e:
يبتغوا (form VIII)
# يَبْتَغُوا (yabtaḡū) /jab.ta.ɣuː/: third-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
# يُبْتَغَوْا (yubtaḡaw) /jub.ta.ɣaw/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِبْتَغَى (ibtaḡā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
